title: More ways to work with text and images
summary:
The text model list grew while the image docs got a careful trim.

GPT-5 Nano and Claude 3.5 Haiku were added with tool support; GPT-5 Nano also accepts image input. The same update added OpenAI o3, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, and reasoning model DeepSeek R1 0528.

The image API docs now describe Flux Kontext image-to-image input without GPT Image examples or a documented `transparent` parameter. Outdated GPT Image and tier announcements were removed from the README and website news. This was a documentation change, not an API behavior change.

The model list also gained upstream identifiers for nova-fast and roblox-rp, plus cached-input pricing for nova-fast. Even gardens need accurate labels.
